title: Pet Products
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run build'

interaction_checks: video loads, autoplays muted, pauses and resumes
navigation, favorites, add to cart, synchronized cart totals, close/Escape and Explore Products
mobile menu, explore, product add and cart

asset_issues.details: Exact supplied assets retained: Sunset Cat Bowl image is a green mouse toy; Cat Toy image is an orange bowl; Cat Bed image is a red mouse toy. No failed media or font downloads.

notes: Native HTML/CSS/JavaScript stack, as supplied in PROMPT.md.
Complete static build in dist/ with relative local assets for /motionsites-results/pet-products/.
Nine media assets and all three requested font families bundled locally.
Corrected inherited avatar positioning and product price clipping, with responsive fit and reduced-motion support.
Cart uses page-session memory and the supplied initial one-item $21 state; no backend specified.
README.md includes build, preview, checks and limitations.
No deployment, push, other design access, subagents or messaging. Ready means ready for review.
